coverage_decisions.decision: Review circulation, evidence, natural/human causes, consequences, storm formation and drought. Retain existing Australian case and diagrams. Correct storm naming (India uses cyclone), century/millennium wording, precession mechanism, and outdated unqualified warming figures. Reject the idea that all water insecurity is meteorological drought.

decisions: Preserved dated Australian case-study evidence, ENSO comparison and both process diagrams.
Expanded evidence limitations, orbital mechanisms, feedback, circulation and storm structure.
Avoided old projections presented as current facts and distinguished frequency from intensity and drought from water insecurity.
